column1: # Provenance of the 926 matching-C targets in rempred/OB64-Decomp PR #1 (head 1b42da35).
# One row per OB64 target: the OB64 symbol, its ROM range (end exclusive) and runtime address,
# the OB64 target kind, the code origin, and the vibe_ogre_decomp source file and function the C
# was converted from. origin = game: derived from the ROM (splat disassembly, m2c drafts, manual
# edits, decomp-permuter) and verified byte for byte with KMC GCC 2.7.2. origin = libmus, n_audio,
# NuSystem or libultra: library code written with the public source of that library as a
# reference (NuSystem, libmus and n_audio from the N64 SDK; libultra from the ultralib
# decompilation), so it may follow that source expression closely.
